accepted_source.price_convention: Yahoo chart v8 indicators.quote regular-session OHLC; includePrePost=false; same-session return=close/open-1; adjclose not used
accepted_source.zero_volume_rule: a zero-volume ETF session is not an informative price-discovery session; any China day whose required intervening US-session inventory contains a zero-volume required-symbol row is excluded from the common diagnostic inventory

causal_clock.included_us_regular_sessions: US exchange dates s satisfying P <= s < D
causal_clock.zero_completed_us_sessions: all per-symbol post-CN returns are 0 because no new US regular-session price-discovery interval exists
causal_clock.multiple_us_sessions: compound all complete regular-session returns in the interval
causal_clock.missing_or_zero_volume_required_session: exclude the China row from the common diagnostic inventory; never fill as zero

fixed_source_representations.china_etf_positive_breadth: fraction of ASHS/ASHR/FXI/MCHI compounded post-CN returns > 0

primary_slice.question: within incumbent low-open calls following a weak prior last hour, is offshore-China post-close repricing systematically higher on actual-high-open days than on actual-low-open days?

required_diagnostics_per_representation: pooled actual-up minus actual-down mean difference
pooled actual-up minus actual-down median difference
annual actual-up minus actual-down mean differences for 2016-2025

supporting_ohr04_disagreement_check.role: supporting only, never a gate because the disagreement set is small
supporting_ohr04_disagreement_check.slice: incumbent down -> rejected last-hour candidate up
supporting_ohr04_disagreement_check.compare: rescued actual highs versus newly created false highs

china_specific_admission_rule.reason: US-listed China ETFs can inherit a broad US common factor while the home market is closed; a later successor needs evidence of China-specific or China-style-relative price discovery rather than generic US risk-on

if_no_china_specific_representation_pass: retain incumbent and close this offshore source identity without candidate selection or 2026 blackbox access
if_china_specific_representation_passes: cloud controller may preregister a new bounded candidate family in a later phase; OHR-06 itself still performs no model selection
forbidden: changing source representation weights or formulas
